item.title: DPW investigating after viral video of trash collector tossing cans
item.description: The D.C. Department of Public Works says they are looking into an incident caught on camera of a sanitation worker tossing two bins in a back alley. On Friday, a user posted on X surveillance footage appearing to show a back alley, and a man in a yellow reflective jacket tossing over a trash can and a recycling bin, scattering trash on the ground. item.title: One woman dead in Fairfax County: police
item.description: Police are investigating the death of a woman in Hybla Valley Monday evening. Officials say an adult female was found with trauma to the upper body at Richmond Hwy and Arlington Dr in Hybla Valley. She was pronounced dead at the scene. The investigation is ongoing. This is a developing story. Stay with FOX 5 DC for updates.
